voice.note: lower = more pauses or unvoiced speech

regions.explanation: From 64.01s to 65.76s (“as a nation together. For”), articulation rate was 7.14 syll/s against 5.06 syll/s in the reference (+41%); that is 1.1× the reference speaker's natural word-to-word variation. Faster articulation compresses the stressed syllables and the micro-pauses listeners use to segment phrases, so key words lose emphasis and comprehension drops. Fix: Slow to the reference pace here and let the pauses between clauses breathe.

fix.edit: time-scaled 1.75 s by x1.41 to 5.06 syll/s
